author: Garrett Ball
title: Isaiah Joe traded to the Detroit Pistons
desc: Isaiah Joe has been traded to the Detroit Pistons for two future second round picks.
impact: Joe brings shooting to a Pistons team that was sorely lacking in three point shooting last year. They were league average in three point percentage, but next to last in threes taken. Joe averaged over 40% from downtown in each of the last four seasons, and should be a great role player addition to the team.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nikola Topic undergoes surgery, expected to be ready for training camp
desc: Nikola Topic underwent successful spine surgery and is expected for training camp in October.
impact: Topic missed his rookie season with a torn ACL and most of his second season due to testicular cancer treatment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chucky Hepburn signs two-way qualifying offer to return to Raptors
desc: Toronto Raptors guard Chucky Hepburn will sign his two-way qualifying offer and return to the team next season.
impact: Hepburn averaged 12.4 points and shot 36.8 percent from deep. He also averaged 8.6 assists and 2.4 steals with the Raptors 905 in the G League. He'll figure to remain in the G League.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Fletcher Loyer signs with Clippers
desc: Purdue's Fletcher Loyer is signing with the LA Clippers.
impact: Loyer scored in double figures during all four seasons in college at Purdue where he had a lot of success. He'll look to prove himself in the Summer League.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Boyd signs with Warriors
desc: Wisconsin's Nick Boyd is signing with the Golden State Warriors.
impact: Boyd is coming off averaging just under 21 points per game in his lone season at Wisconsin. He'll look to prove himself in the Summer League.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ja Morant expected to be traded
desc: The Grizzlies are expected to move on from Ja Morant this offseason.
impact: ESPN's Brian Windhorst said he "can't see Morant playing for the Grizzlies again." It is unclear what the current trade market is for him. He has two years left on his contract.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Donte DiVincenzo expected to remain with Timberwolves
desc: The Timberwolves are not expected to trade Donte DiVincenzo.
impact: DiVincenzo suffered a ruptured right Achilles tendon in the first round of the playoffs. He is expected to miss most of the upcoming season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jamal Shead has team option picked up by Raptors
desc: The Raptors have picked up Jamal Shead's option for 2026-27.
impact: Shead appeared in all 82 regular-season games last year. He'll remain in a depth role in the back court for Toronto.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jericho Sims to pick up player option with Bucks
desc: Jericho Sims intends to pick up his player option for the 2026-27 season with the Bucks.
impact: Sims appeared in 67 games last season, averaging 5.0 points and 5.5 rebounds. He is likely to remain in a reserve role for Milwaukee.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jaxon Kohler signs Exhibit 10 contract with Jazz
desc: The Jazz signed Jaxon Kohler to an Exhibit 10 contract.
impact: Kohler averaged close to a double-double in his final season at Michigan State last year. He will be able to go through training camp on the deal before opening the season in the G League.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jimmy Butler III (knee) progressing in recovery from torn ACL
desc: Jimmy Butler III told reporters he is progressing in his recovery from a torn right ACL.
impact: Butler said he is making strides in his recovery, but he has not resumed running. He may not be ready to go when training camp begins for Golden State in late September.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Jalen Duren planning to explore sign-and-trade options
desc: Jalen Duren is expected to explore sign-and-trade options after he and his camp were underwhelmed by the Pistons initial offer. Sam Amick of The Athletic noted Duren and the team are at an impasse after a season of mixed results. On the one hand, Duren had a great 2025-26 season, but floundered in the playoffs. Given that, the team is hesitant to hand him the massive contract he is now eligible for because of his All-NBA selection.
impact: This could have massive implications for the Pistons in 2026 if Duren leaves, especially since they traded Isaiah Stewart during the draft. If Duren finds himself on another team this offseason, the Pistons will have a big hole to fill in their starting lineup, and that player could have a lot of fantasy value given Detroit's style of play.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kevin Porter Jr. picks up player option with Bucks
desc: Kevin Porter Jr. has picked up his player option for the 2026-27 season.
impact: Porter was limited to 38 games last season due to injuries. He is in line to see a much bigger role as long as he can stay healthy with the departure of Giannis Antetokounmpo.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mouhamed Gueye has team option exercised by Hawks
desc: The Hawks exercised Mouhamed Gueye's option for the 2026-27 season.
impact: Gueye appeared in a career-high 77 games last season. He is likely to remain in a reserve role off the bench.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Karlo Matkovic has team option exercised by Pelicans
desc: The Pelicans exercised Karl Matković's option for the 2026-27 season.
impact: Matkovic appeared in 62 games last season. He is likely to remain in a reserve role for New Orleans.
